diagrams.title: **No boss, just handoffs
diagrams.caption: **No boss, just handoffs.** Any agent can pass control to any other. Whoever picks up the task receives a briefing built by the swarm: the handoff message, the original task, who has worked on it, and any notes passed along.
diagrams.svg:

Four agents, level designer, game designer, narrative designer and difficulty balancer, are arranged around a briefing that the swarm builds for whoever goes next: the handoff message, the original task, the agents who worked so far, notes passed along in handoffs, and the other available agents. Any agent can hand off to any other using the handoff_to_agent tool. There is no supervisor. diagrams.title: **Forward-only vs loops
diagrams.caption: **Forward-only vs loops.** Production workflows mostly use **DAGs**, so that's the focus here. (Strands also supports cyclic graphs, with safety limits such as a cap on total node executions and timeouts.)
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 300" aria-label="Two kinds of graph. Left, a directed acyclic graph: risk check, then fraud detection, then shipping; arrows only point forward. Right, a cyclic graph: developer writes code, reviewer flags issues, back to developer for fixes, looping until the reviewer approves, then done." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-risk" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-risk" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

        <text x="36" y="50" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">DAG: directed, acyclic</text><text x="36" y="74" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">arrows only point forward, never loop back</text>

        <rect x="210" y="120" width="150" height="64" rx="12" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="285" y="158" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">fraud check</text>
        <path d="M360 152 H390" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
        <rect x="394" y="120" width="124" height="64" rx="12" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="456" y="158" text-anchor="middle" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">shipping</text>

diagrams.title: **Every path drawn in advance
diagrams.caption: **Every path drawn in advance.** Three ways in, one meeting point at inventory, two possible endings. The labels on the edges are the exact words the routing code looks for. The dashed box isn't a node: low-risk orders go straight from risk analysis to the inventory check.
diagrams.svg:
<svg class="dimmable" viewBox="0 0 1100 520" aria-label="Graph pattern for order processing. An order is received and goes to the risk analyzer. The risk analyzer routes it one of three ways: high-value orders go to manual review, suspicious orders go to advanced fraud check, low-risk orders from trusted customers go directly to inventory check. Manual review and fraud check also lead to inventory check. If items are in stock, the order goes to shipping, which generates a label and ships it. If out of stock, the order goes to refund, and the customer is refunded." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-risk" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-risk" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
